description:
Join Our Mission to Save Animal Lives with All The Fauna

At All The Fauna, we are dedicated to making a real difference in the lives of animals in need. As a business that raises funds for animal nonprofits, we are committed to supporting shelters, rescues, and wildlife organizations by donating 10% of every purchase made on our website.

Our Donation Program is designed to empower animal nonprofits to raise funds effortlessly while spreading awareness about your mission. Here’s why joining is a win for your organization:

• Seamless Fundraising: Earn 10% of every sale made through your unique link, promo code, or QR code—without additional effort from your team. Cash out via Venmo or Paypal.

• Increased Visibility: Partner with us to reach animal lovers who care about your mission and are eager to help.

• Promotional Resources: Get access to a ready-to-use media kit with social media posts, email templates, and graphics to share with your supporters.

Together, We Can Make a Difference

Join All The Fauna today and turn everyday purchases into life-saving funds for animals. Together, we can provide the resources, care, and love that every animal deserves.

Must be A 501c3 registered animal welfare nonprofit to qualify.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to All The Fauna! Thanks for applying to our Donation program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and a partner (“you” or “partner”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Partner agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as a Partner or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Partner Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Partner Program Registration.

2. Partner Links and Coupon

Partner link is automatically generated, but you can also generate a partner link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Partner may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Donations and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a donation amount which is calculated based on Donation structure. Donation amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fees (tax, shipping cost, etc).

For a Partner to receive a donation, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Donation Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Partner Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of donation if displayed in Donations tab, any paid donation will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on partner channels.

5. Removal from Donation Program

If a partner wishes to be removed from the partner program, they can do so by contacting: admin@allthefauna.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Partner Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to admin@allthefauna.com for support.
